samples.scope: Complete source continuation without premature cut

humanAnswer: speech remain recognizable, music preserves the sound and phrasing
limits: Acceptance covers submitted opening speech, characteristic musical phrase and complete ending continuation; no PCM identity, original interrupt-race equivalence or uninterrupted whole-title listening is claimed.

modelAssistanceReview.decision: Frozen speech trial completed; retain as experimental supporting evidence, no further model call.
modelAssistanceReview.reason: Both silence and ordinary-speech controls pass; original and independent opening transcripts agree apart from punctuation. No ground-truth intelligibility or musical-quality claim follows.
modelAssistanceReview.nextReview: New speech source, changed model/prompt/preprocessing or substantive musical revision.
